title: The range between valley and desert
text: The Tehachapi Mountains form a range about 40 miles long in southern Kern County and northwestern Los Angeles County. They form part of the boundary between the San Joaquin Valley and the Mojave Desert. Oak woodland, oak savanna, and chaparral grow on the slopes, with mixed evergreen forest at higher elevations. Mountain lions, black bears, and mule deer live in the range.
